note: GitHub is an execution connector, not one of the nine target AI platforms. No external model API handoff was tested in this run.

platforms.name: ChatGPT
platforms.authentication: current ChatGPT session and permitted tools
platforms.permissions: public web reads and repository operations permitted by connected GitHub tool; no secret access
platforms.data_flow: public sources and repository evidence into structured ledger
platforms.task_assignment: lead evidence synthesis and maintain forecast/handoff schema

platforms.name: Claude
platforms.authentication: scoped API credential in protected secret store when authorized
platforms.permissions: read-only evidence bundle; no repository write or trading authority
platforms.data_flow: hashed source bundle in, structured objections out

platforms.name: Grok
platforms.permissions: public content only; no private-account or deceptive access
platforms.data_flow: public discussion URLs and timestamps in, claim-labelled observations out
platforms.fallback: public web search and source registry

platforms.name: Gemini
platforms.permissions: read-only document package; no personal-account access
platforms.data_flow: public filings and PDFs in, extracted facts with page/line provenance out
platforms.task_assignment: independent SEC filing and document extraction

platforms.name: Copilot
platforms.authentication: GitHub app or organization grant, if explicitly authorized
platforms.permissions: read-only repository by default; PR comment/write only after approval; no main write
platforms.data_flow: selected diff and tests in, review findings out
platforms.fallback: GitHub Actions and local static analysis

platforms.name: Codex
platforms.permissions: branch and PR scope only; no force-push, merge, deployment or secret access
platforms.data_flow: issue and source context in, patch/test evidence out
platforms.task_assignment: minimal deterministic fixes and regression tests

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.permissions: read model/dataset by default; no model upload or deployment
platforms.data_flow: public feature datasets in, model metadata and evaluation output out

platforms.name: Kaggle
platforms.authentication: scoped Kaggle API token when authorized
platforms.permissions: read public datasets; notebook publication only with approval
platforms.data_flow: versioned feature dataset in, reproducible notebook results out

platforms.name: Databricks
platforms.permissions: read-only data access and explicitly scoped job-run; no secret reads or production deployment
platforms.data_flow: timestamped source snapshots in, versioned feature/model metrics out
platforms.task_assignment: historical feature store and walk-forward evaluation

least_privilege_defaults: No provider secret in repository or prompt artifacts.
No agent can merge, force-push, deploy, trade or mutate production data.
Read-only access first; scoped branch/PR or job permission only after explicit approval.
Public and authorized data only; no private account scraping or deceptive access.
independent_deliberation_protocol: Assign separate research questions and source sets.
Require source URL, publication time, capture time and raw hash.
Separate confirmed fact, sourced claim, inference, speculation and unknown.
Record each model's objections and counterevidence.
Resolve by source quality, independent corroboration and reproducibility, not vote count.
Keep minority objections in the ledger.
Require independent red-team review before forecast admission.
